reference.title: 5 skills for your first lakh (golden hand dial)
reference.notes: Gold blackletter hook, a moss-stone hand holding a star dial as the chapter device, dark starry top panels, big words behind the head, a phone b-roll, black CTA. 35 scene changes (~0.4/s). Clone (ishaan-motion, library sfx where the reference has none): data/refs/r3/clone-motion.

parts.name: Gold blackletter lockup
parts.about: a small line over a big blackletter word in a gold heat gradient (near-white top to burnt base), one soft gold bloom behind, a short flicker as it ignites, a small dated line under it

parts.name: Glowing skill tiles
parts.about: five dark tiles with gold rims and line icons pop in a 3-2 grid at chest height on the counted noun (jittered springs), float, and shrink away before the cut

parts.name: Stone hand holding a star dial
parts.about: a moss-stone hand holds a dark disc with thin rings and a bevelled white star; the chapters sit round it in blackletter, the lit one large; each chapter the dial turns to the next and the star spins a little; at the end all chapters show at once

parts.name: Hand rises, camera dives in
parts.about: the stone hand rises over the speaker from below (0.45 s), then the camera dives in log space onto the dial as the night ground takes over

parts.name: Starry night ground
parts.about: warm near-black with grain and a few twinkling stars (some with a four-point glint): the ground of every top panel

parts.name: Master File folder
parts.about: a yellow folder pops in, a cursor glides in and clicks it, the folder lifts and documents spring out to either side with their labels

parts.name: Bullet list with tool chips
parts.about: a blackletter chapter title, then bullets slide in one per spoken item; the first carries small coloured tool chips that pop in after it

parts.name: Website cards with blackletter captions
parts.about: three dark website cards spring in left to right on their words, each with its own colour bloom and a blackletter caption under it

parts.name: A numbered text card
parts.about: a bold title, then five numbered lines fading up one after another (a dense how-to card to pause on)

parts.name: Bad vs good thumbnail cards
parts.about: a video card labelled 'Bad Thumbnail' with a 'Weak Title' arrow, swapped on its word for the good one with 'Good Title'; labels and arrows draw on

parts.name: Icon flow with marching dashes
parts.about: icons pop left to right on their words with labels under them, joined by dashed connectors whose dashes keep marching

parts.name: One person vs a group
parts.about: a person icon with its label slides left as a group icon pops in on the right with a '>' between them

parts.name: Mind-map from a folder
parts.about: branches draw out of a folder to four corners, one per spoken question, each ending in a dot and its question

parts.name: Phone b-roll with stacked words
parts.about: a full-frame b-roll (hands filming with a phone, a subject on its screen, a red record dot) with the verbs slamming in stacked on the left

parts.name: Sentence chunks at chest height
parts.about: 2-4 word chunks (up to 20 characters) in a heavy white sans, each word arriving on its stamp; on the seam when the frame is split

parts.name: Black comment card
parts.about: a black frame: small 'comment' top-left, the keyword slams in the condensed face, a small line right-aligned under it

uses.role: 3 MONTHS, INFLUENCERS, GREAT behind the head
